title: Agent activity records
responsibility: Defines the stored registration, heartbeat and completion records, plus the types used to report agents and repository activity.

outputs.name: agentRegistrationSchema
outputs.description: A strict Zod object schema for a registration record: schemaVersion is 1; id, label, and registeredAt are nonempty strings; provider, model, and processStartedAt are nullable strings; pid is a nullable positive integer; ttlSeconds is a positive integer. The TTL is how long after a heartbeat the agent may be quiet and still count as working; extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentBeatSchema
outputs.description: A strict Zod object schema for an agent's latest heartbeat: at is a nonempty string, branch, task, and loop are nullable strings, and units is an array of nonempty strings. Extra fields are rejected.

outputs.name: agentEndSchema
outputs.description: A strict Zod object schema for an agent's final record: at is a nonempty string, status is completed or failed, and outcome is a nullable string. It represents how the agent ended; extra fields are rejected.
